mapper.sql: companies.name AS name, companies.vat_number AS vatNumber, companies.id AS id, currency_centers.id AS currencyCenterId, currency_centers.name AS currencyCenterName, companies.business_number AS officeTelephone, companies.other_number AS otherTelephone, companies.fax_number AS faxNumber, companies.email_address AS email, companies.address AS address, companies.address_kh AS addressInKhmer, companies.photo AS photo, companies.photo AS photo, companies.created AS created, companies.modified AS modified, CONCAT(users1.first_name, ' ', users1.last_name ) AS createdBy, CONCAT(users2.first_name, ' ', users2.last_name ) AS modifiedBy

FROM companies LEFT JOIN users AS users1 ON users1.id = companies.created_by LEFT JOIN users AS users2 ON users2.id = companies.modified_by LEFT JOIN currency_centers AS currency_centers ON currency_centers.id = companies.currency_center_id
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(id) FROM companies WHERE is_active = 1 AND (name = #{name}) AND id != #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO companies ( name, `currency_center_id`, `vat_number`, `business_number`, other_number, fax_number, email_address, address ,address_kh, photo, created, created_by, is_active ) VALUES ( #{company.name}, #{company.baseCurrencyId}, #{company.vatNo}, #{company.officeTelephone}, #{company.otherTelephone}, #{company.faxNumber}, #{company.email}, #{company.address}, #{company.addressInKhmer}, #{company.photo}, NOW(), #{company.createdBy}, #{company.isActive})
